answer: The trellis counter is kept in shale and cedar publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4353 identities would post 4069 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
